categories.atom: Atomic UI elements — button, input, chip, tabs
categories.layout: Layout & navigation — appbar, sidebar, modal, table, panel
categories.asset: Foundation assets — icons, avatars, illustrations, logos (catalog of names; Tabler icons via @tabler/icons; custom assets exported from Figma)

items.name: Avatar
items.description: User profile picture asset. 41 variants: 20 male personas (ava-man-1 to ava-man-20), 20 female personas (ava-woman-1 to ava-woman-20), and 1 placeholder (ava-placeholder-user). Each is a 128×128px frame with an illustration and a border overlay. Used in AppBar, Sidebar hover state, CandidateCard, ContentBlock(OptionMenus), and NotificationCard.

items.name: OptionMenu
items.description: Action illustration icons for the DropdownMenu(OptionMenus) and ContentBlock(OptionMenus) layouts. 24 variants covering HR workflow actions: email, consent, import, export, reporting, and finance operations. Each is a 64×64px illustration icon.

items.name: CharacterExpression
items.description: Mascot character illustrations expressing emotions. 40 variants across 14 emotion categories. Used in empty states, loading screens, confirmations, and modal body (ModalContent). Each is a 128×128px illustration.

items.name: AnimatedIllustration
items.description: GIF animation illustrations for loading states, redirects, and process feedback. 14 variants for specific app states. Each is a 96×96px animated GIF frame (static in Figma). Used in interstitial screens, loading overlays, and step transitions.

items.name: ComplexIllustration
items.description: Larger full-scene illustration assets. 2 variants: document-preview (used in document viewer contexts) and privacy-policy (used on privacy/consent pages). Each is a 172×172px layered illustration.

items.name: Icon (Tabler)
items.description: Primary icon library. 272 Tabler icons at 24×24px. Stroke-based vectors — color is set by the parent element's fill/color, not the icon itself. Used across all UI components (buttons, inputs, table rows, menus, etc.).

items.name: Icon (Tabler Extended)
items.description: Extended Tabler icon set. 100 additional icons not in the primary set. Same 24×24px format and stroke-based rendering as Icon(Tabler). Both sets together form the complete icon library.

items.name: Icon (Custom)
items.description: Custom-designed icons specific to Elabram. 94 variants across 7 groups: navigation icons (default + active states), system status icons, social media brand icons, country flags, file type icons, and folder icons. 24×24px SVG format.

items.name: Logo
items.description: Client/company logo placeholder set. 10 variants (logo-1 to logo-10) representing different client organizations. 64×64px vector logo placeholders. Used in ContentBlock(OptionMenus) as company avatars, in CandidateCard for employer branding, and in AppBar when switching client context.

items.name: Button
items.description: Primary interactive element for triggering actions. Supports five visual styles and three states.

items.name: IconButton
items.description: Square button that contains only an icon. Same styles as Button but no label.

items.name: SplitButton
items.description: Two-part button: primary action (left) + dropdown trigger (right). 2px gap between parts.

items.name: CustomButton
items.description: Neutral low-emphasis button for navigation and breadcrumb. No brand color — uses system surface. Turns muted gray on hover.

items.name: Chip
items.description: Compact label for tags, filters, selections. Three styles (Neutral/Colored/Gradient), three sizes (MD/SM/CC). Full-radius pill.

items.name: StatusChip
items.description: Read-only status indicator. Semantic color presets per status. Not interactive.

items.name: Toast
items.description: Transient notification overlay. Semantic status types × three visual styles. Auto-dismisses.

items.name: Input
items.description: General-purpose single-line text input. Covers Basic, Search, Password, Number, DatePicker, Dropdown. Single and Multi value modes.

items.name: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text input. Same state tokens as Input. Built on FormInputField.

items.name: RichTextEditor
items.description: WYSIWYG editor with formatting toolbar. For email composition, cover letters, and formatted long-form content.

items.name: FormInputField
items.description: Reusable field shell used inside Input, Textarea, RichTextEditor. Handles background, border, radius, padding for Single and Multi layouts.

items.name: FormControl
items.description: Selection controls: Checkbox, Radio, Switch. Each has Enabled/Disabled states and Selected/Unselected/Indeterminate values.

items.name: RangeSlider
items.description: Dual-handle range input for selecting a min–max numeric range.

items.name: Breadcrumb
items.description: Horizontal navigation trail from root to current page. Built by composing CustomButton items separated by chevron separators.

items.name: DropdownMenu
items.description: Floating menu panel triggered by button or right-click. Five layout types.

items.name: Tabs
items.description: Horizontal tab navigation. Two styles: Basic (pill in container) and Underline (borderless with bottom indicator). Text-only, icon-only, or icon+text items.

items.name: InfoBlock
items.description: Flexible data display unit. 10 types covering: section titles, icon+body text, icon+body+action, multi-value rich content, label+small body, and experience layout. Used extensively as the building block inside CandidateCard, FilterField, NotificationCard, and CandidateInfoBlock.

items.name: ContentBlock
items.description: Surface-soft row block pattern for filter panels and lists. 8 types: menu with arrow, accordion (open/closed), option menus with avatar, toggle fields (checkbox list), applied filters chip list, displayed filters, and option menus big.

items.name: QuickSuggest
items.description: Horizontal row of pre-defined suggestion chips shown below a filter field input. Lets users quickly select common filter values without typing. Always embedded inside FilterField.

items.name: FilterField
items.description: Individual filter row inside FilterPanel. 5 types: General (text/dropdown input + checkbox list + suggestions), Date (date picker variant), Phone (phone input), MaxMin (two side-by-side inputs), Slider (RangeSlider). All share white background with soft border.

items.name: FileUpload
items.description: File upload area for 5 document types: CV, Photo, Document, Sheet, Archive. Each type has Default (empty dropzone) and Uploaded (showing preview + file info) states. Dropzone uses brand.brand dashed border; uploaded preview uses surface-strong background.

items.name: CandidateInfoBlock
items.description: Data display block for candidate profile fields inside a Panel. 5 types: SingleValue (label + one value + action icon), MultiValue (label + chip array), Grouped (surface-strong card with multiple InfoBlocks), Experience (timeline row with company/role/duration), SingleMulti (label + multiple single-value rows).

items.name: FilterPanel
items.description: Complete vertical filter drawer composing multiple FilterField rows. Has a sticky header (search/title), a scrollable body of FilterField rows, and a sticky footer with Clear and Apply buttons.

items.name: CandidateCard
items.description: Candidate summary card for list views. Shows avatar, name, headline, key info rows (location, salary, experience), status chips, and action buttons. Uses Shadow/Smooth for card elevation.

items.name: ResumeCard
items.description: Resume template selection card. Shows a visual preview thumbnail, template name, and owner. Hover state reveals action buttons (preview, select, more). Used inside the Resume Template Panel.

items.name: ConsentToast
items.description: Domain-specific toast for data consent notifications. Three copywriting variants with different messaging. Copywriting 1 & 2 use Warning style; Copywriting 3 uses Error style. Built on top of Toast(Filled). Includes action buttons for consent response.

items.name: NotificationCard
items.description: Individual notification row in the NotificationList. Three states: Default (white), Hover1 (header highlighted), Hover2 (detail highlighted). Each row has a summary header and an expandable detail section.

items.name: NotificationList
items.description: Complete notification feed panel. Sticky header with title and mark-all-read action. Scrollable list of NotificationCard rows.

items.name: DocumentGallery
items.description: Multi-page document preview gallery. Shows all pages of a resume/document as a vertical stack of white page cards. Four template styles: ModernProfessional, CreativePortfolio, FreshGraduate, ExampleOfPrivacyPolicy.

items.name: EmbedViewer
items.description: Dark-theme embedded viewer for VideoPlayer and DocumentViewer. Uses the component.embed-* token set (dark gray UI). Includes a top control bar, a canvas area, and playback/navigation controls.

items.name: WhatsAppChat
items.description: WhatsApp-style chat interface for consent communication. Three variants: Default (generic chat), ConsentRecruiterPOV (recruiter sending consent request), ConsentCandidatePOV (candidate receiving consent). Uses social.social-white background with system border.

items.name: InteractiveFlow
items.description: Multi-step interactive overlay flows for complex operations. 26 variants covering: AI Generate Text (6 steps), Consent Share Link (4 steps), Salary (Edit/Default), Half/Full Address, Email Carbon Copy (2 steps), Generate CV in PDF (3 steps), Sync Candidate Data (4 steps), Notification Filter (2 steps). Each variant is a Modal-like overlay with step-specific content.

items.name: AppBar
items.description: Top navigation bar. Fixed at the top of every page. Contains the logo, navigation menu items, user avatar, and notification icon. Two variants: DefaultUser (logged-in user's own session) and OtherUser (viewing as another user).

items.name: Sidebar
items.description: Vertical navigation rail on the left side. Default state shows icon-only menu items. Hover state expands to show icon + label. Uses dark theme (component.sidebar-background) inside a near-black outer shell.

items.name: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation bar for paginated data. Default shows row count, page buttons, and items-per-page selector. Compact shows only count and prev/next.

items.name: ScrollBar
items.description: Custom scrollbar overlay for scrollable containers. Vertical and horizontal variants. Track uses system border color; thumb uses white with Smooth shadow for lift effect.

items.name: Panel
items.description: Slide-in side panel that displays detailed content alongside the main view. Two layout types: SingleCard (one full-width content card) and MultiCard (grid of cards in the body). Composed of PanelSection parts (header, body, footer).

items.name: PanelSection
items.description: Individual section zones of a Panel or DataTable: header, sub-header, footer, document viewer header, video player bar, text editor bar. Used as building blocks inside Panel and DataTable.

items.name: Modal
items.description: Full-screen overlay dialog for critical actions and confirmations. Two types: System (body has surface-strong background with white card inside) and Browser (body is plain white — used for document/file content).

items.name: ModalContent
items.description: Content slot patterns for the Modal body. Five types cover: Default (text + illustration), Form (inputs + controls + table), ListCard (selectable items), FileCard (document items with actions), FileContentOnly (file list).

items.name: DataTable
items.description: Full data table composed of TableColumn headers, TableRow rows, ScrollBar for horizontal scroll, and Pagination footer. ReplaceMe variant is the empty template; Candidates is a pre-filled example.

items.name: TableColumn
items.description: Header cell pattern for DataTable columns. 11 types covering: title-only, sortable title, checkbox select-all, inline search, inline select, date picker, and the ReplaceMe slot. All share surface-strong background with border.

items.name: TableRow
items.description: Data row cell pattern for DataTable. 17 types covering: text, links, multi-text, chips, status chips, action buttons, checkboxes, photos, indicators, currency, and the ReplaceMe slot. All share white background with soft border.

items.name: Sample Pages 1 — Candidate Pipeline
items.description: Candidate recruitment pipeline view. Shows a horizontal arrow-shaped pipeline stepper above a data table. The stepper visualizes candidates' progression through recruitment stages. Commonly used for requisition-level candidate tracking.

items.name: Sample Pages 2 — Candidate List
items.description: Full-width candidate data table view for a requisition. Shows a filtered list of candidates with their onboarding/pre-boarding status. Has a filter bar with active filter chip row, a DataTable with inline status chips and action columns, and pagination.

items.name: Sample Pages 3 — Wizard Form: Offer Setup
items.description: Multi-step wizard form for creating an offer. Step 1: Offer Setup. Contains customer selector, position/department inputs, site location, and contract type selection cards. The wizard has a left step navigator and right form content, with a sticky footer for navigation.

items.name: Sample Pages 4 — Wizard Form: Salary & Income
items.description: Multi-step wizard form for creating an offer. Step 2: Salary & Income. Contains currency selector, basic salary input, wage type selector, working days, payday date, currency conversion toggle, and an allowance table with inline editable rows.

items.name: Sample Pages 5 — Candidate Card Grid
items.description: Candidate browsing view as a card grid. Left: full FilterPanel drawer with filter fields and quick suggestions. Top: list toolbar with view selector, keyword search, Apply button, compact pagination and view controls. Right: responsive grid of CandidateCard items showing avatar, name, match score, info chips, contact rows, experience entries and result tags.

items.name: Sample Pages 6 — Candidate Directory Table
items.description: Flat candidate directory as a wide data table with per-column filters. Same page header and list toolbar as the card grid view. Table: leading Action column with a SplitButton per row, checkbox column, photo column, then data columns whose headers embed inline search inputs (FullSearch) or inline selects (FullSelect). Horizontal scroll for overflow columns.

items.name: Sample Pages 7 — Resume Builder (Editor)
items.description: Resume Builder opened as a full-screen modal (Browser type: plain white chrome). Header: 'Resume Builder' title + close X. Mode toolbar: Editor/Design tab switch left, Save Template split button + Download button right. Body: left editor sidebar (ResumeBuilderPanel Home view with Displayed/Hidden section lists) and right preview canvas on surface-strong showing the rendered resume document.

items.name: Sample Pages 8 — Resume Builder (Design)
items.description: Resume Builder full-screen modal, Design mode. Same modal chrome and toolbar as the Editor view, but with the 'Design' tab active (and 'Editor' inactive). Left sidebar becomes 'Customize Your Template': stacked white cards with dropdown setting rows (Template, Margin, Spacing, Customization). Right preview canvas is identical to the Editor view.

items.name: Sample Pages 9 — Bulk Send for Approval
items.description: Bulk task flow opened as a full-screen modal (Browser type). Header: 'Bulk Send for Approval' + close X. Body: three panes — left candidates list (selectable rows with status chips and remove actions), center approval actions form (apply-mode cards, tabs, contract/approver form cards), right contract document preview with zoom controls. Footer: Cancel left, Send for Approval (disabled until valid) right. Left and right panes are collapsible.

items.name: Sample Pages 10 — Bulk Send for Approval (Collapsed Panes)
items.description: Bulk Send for Approval with both side panes collapsed into narrow icon rails. Left rail: expand icon button, 'Total: 6' caption, then one initials chip per candidate (e.g. AR, BA, CA, DW, EC, FN) stacked vertically — the selected candidate's chip is highlighted. Right rail: expand icon button + a single document icon button. The center approval actions pane stretches across the freed width. Header, center pane content and footer are identical to page-09.

items.name: Sample Pages 11 — Employment Detail Side Panel (Summary)
items.description: Employee/candidate employment detail opened as a wide right-anchored side panel (Panel, MultiCard) over a scrimmed base page. Panel header: candidate switcher dropdown + prev/next buttons + collapse + close. Summary bar: avatar + full name + status/info chips. Body: two columns — left Employment History tree (company > contract > version cards), right contract detail card with a 6-step approval stage stepper, underline tabs and a summary grid of icon+label/value blocks.

items.name: Sample Pages 12 — Employment Detail Side Panel (Snapshots)
items.description: Same employment detail side panel as page-11, showing an in-review contract (V1 · Main) with the Snapshots tab active. Stage stepper: only step 1 (KA REVIEW) reached; steps 2-6 upcoming. Header action becomes a suggested next action ('Next: Edit Contract') split button. Snapshots tab: grouped snapshot timeline — 'MAIN RECORD' group strip, then snapshot rows (CR01-CR04) on a vertical dot timeline; 'REQUEST CHANGE #1' group strip below.

items.name: FilterBlockPanel
items.description: Panel body content for the filter block panel. Contains a search input at the top, followed by filter category sections. Slots directly into Panel(SingleCard) body — no background/padding of its own.

items.name: ActionPanel
items.description: Panel body content for quick-action forms. Two states: Filled (form has data) and Unfilled (empty initial state). Contains stacked form inputs. Domain use: bulk actions, quick-edit, batch assignment on candidate records.

items.name: CandidateDetailsPanel
items.description: The main candidate detail panel body. 8 variants covering the candidate tabs: Profile, Interview, Comment, and History sub-tabs (MH/CA/CH/LA/JA). Each variant shows a different view of the candidate's data using CandidateInfoBlock, Timeline entries, and note/comment sections.

items.name: ResumeTemplatePanel
items.description: Panel body content for browsing and selecting resume templates. Three variants: PublicTemplate (community templates), MyTemplate (user's own), PrebuiltTemplate (system defaults). Contains a ResumeCard grid and action buttons.

items.name: ResumeBuilderPanel
items.description: Panel body content for the resume builder editor. 25 variants covering all resume section editors: Home (default view), Personal Information, Working Experience (collapse/expand), Formal Education (collapse/expand), Skills, Courses, Achievements, Additional Information, and a Design Tab for template/style customization. Two-column layout: left navigation + right editor.

items.name: ConsentRequestPanel
items.description: Panel body content for sending consent requests. 4 variants: ManualConsent (checkbox acknowledgment + textarea), SendEmail (email form + attachment), RequestConsent1 and RequestConsent2 (different consent request flows). Contains form inputs, file upload, and consent controls.

items.name: SmartContentPanel
items.description: AI-powered content generation panel body. 4-step flow: SelectClient → ChooseOptions → ComposeEmail → GenerateResume. Each step shows relevant controls with progress feedback. Uses Toast(Filled) for AI generation status.

items.name: ConsentInfoPanel
items.description: Panel body content showing consent status and history. 21 variants combining: consent method (ShareLink/ManualUpload/SendEmail) × status (Accepted/Pending/Declined) × tab (Details/Events/ProofOfConsent). Shows consent timeline, status details, and proof documentation.

items.name: ReferencePanel
items.description: Panel body content for viewing candidate reference letters. Two states: Read (letter has been opened) and Unread (not yet viewed). Shows the reference letter document viewer on the left and metadata/actions on the right.

items.name: FileInfoPanel
items.description: Panel body content for file management actions. 3 variants: FileHistory (shows version history), EditTag (tag editor for a file), LinkTo (links a file to a job/candidate). Each shows relevant file info and action controls.

items.name: WorkflowPanel
items.description: Panel body content for candidate workflow/pipeline management. Shows the candidate's current status in the recruitment workflow, stage history, and available workflow actions. Uses Toast for important stage alerts.

items.name: NotificationPanel
items.description: Panel body content for the notification/activity feed. Shows activity grouped by category: General, Jobs, Contract, Invoice, Payroll. Each category section is a collapsible group of activity items.
